# Maintain the published book and release

The R package and Quarto book share the [kkang7/CDSeq2 repository](https://github.com/kkang7/CDSeq2). The book is published at [kkang7.github.io/CDSeq2](https://kkang7.github.io/CDSeq2/), and GitHub Pages is configured to use GitHub Actions. The workflow rebuilds the website when changes reach `main`; long simulations do not run during the website build.

## Preview and check changes

From the existing repository checkout:

```bash
quarto render book
python3 tools/check_book.py
quarto preview book
```

Edit chapters in `book/chapters/` and navigation in `book/_quarto.yml`. Quarto 1.7.32 is pinned in the publishing workflow. Statistical examples are displayed as code; run the separate tutorial to regenerate its results.

## Publish updates

Review and commit the intended changes in the existing Git checkout, then push `main`. Monitor **Actions → Publish Quarto book** for rendering, asset checks and deployment. The separate **Package checks** workflow checks the R package, synthetic tutorial and frozen scorer on Linux and macOS.

A working website confirms the documentation build; it does not mean that all native benchmark simulations ran on GitHub. The [reproduction chapter](reproduce.qmd) distinguishes figures, diagnostics and native reruns.

## Preserve research releases

CDSeq2 0.1.0 is archived at [10.5281/zenodo.23489824](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23489824), with [release downloads](https://github.com/kkang7/CDSeq2/releases/tag/v0.1.0) for the source package, exact repository snapshot, manuscript bundle and checksums. Zenodo automatic preservation is enabled for this repository.

For a future release, update the version and citation metadata, verify the assets and package checks, then create a new tag and GitHub release. Preserve existing tags. Confirm the resulting Zenodo record and add its DOI to the documentation and manuscript. Later citation/status changes on `main` do not alter the archived release snapshot.

The [data inventory](data.qmd) links the reconstructed brain inputs and compact independent-cohort benchmark. Raw ROSMAP source files remain available from their original source; generated native-fit caches stay outside Git.
